title: कक्षा ८ को नेपाली भाषा पाठ्यपुस्तकमा कार्यमूलक व्याकरणको प्रयोग
nepali: प्रस्तुत लेखमा कक्षा ८ को नेपाली भाषा पाठ्यपुस्तकमा प्रयुक्त कार्यमूलक व्याकरणका विषयवस्तुहरूलाई पाठ्यव्रmमअनुरूपता, छनोट र स्तरण, पाठस“गको सम्बद्धता र कार्यमूलकता तथा उदाहरण र प्रयोग अभ्यासका आधारमा विश्लेषण गरिएको छ । गुणात्मक ढाँचामा संरचित यस लेखमा तथ्याङ्क सङ्कलन पुस्तकालयीय अध्ययन र तथ्याङ्कको विश्लेषण वर्णनात्मक विधिबाट गरिएको छ । अध्ययनको प्राथमिक स्रोतका रूपमा कक्षा ८ को नेपाली भाषा पाठ्यपुस्तकलाई लिइएको छ । निर्धारित पाठ्यपुस्तकबाट कार्यमूलक व्याकरणका विषयवस्तुहरू पहिचान गरी तिनको वितरण र प्रस्तुतिलाई तालिकामा प्रस्तुत गरिएको छ भने तालिकाको व्याख्या विश्लेषणबाट निष्कर्षमा पुगिएको  छ । अध्ययनबाट पाठ्यक्रमअनुरूपका अधिकांश विषय कार्यमूलक व्याकरणमा समेटिएको, वाच्य, शब्दवर्ग र कारक, विभक्ति तथा विभक्ति नियमको प्रयोग आदि विषयहरू जटिल प्रकृतिका छनोट गरिएको, वाच्य, कारक र विभक्ति तथा लेख्य चिह्नका विषयवस्तुहरू रेखीय स्तरणमा संयोजन गरिएको, पाठ सम्बद्ध र उदाहरण प्रयोगमा आधारित विषयहरूको कमी रहेको, कार्यमूलकताका सम्बन्धमा अस्पष्टता रहेको तथा व्याकरणका केही विषयवस्तुलाई सैद्धान्तिक स्वरूपमा प्रस्तुत गरिएको पाइएको छ ।
american_english: In this article, the functional grammar topics utilized in the eighth-grade Nepali language textbook are analyzed on the basis of curriculum conformity, selection and grading, relevance to texts and functionality, and examples and practice exercises. Structured within a qualitative framework, data collection in this article was conducted through library research and data analysis was performed using descriptive methods. The eighth-grade Nepali language textbook was taken as the primary source for the study. Having identified functional grammar topics from the prescribed textbook, their distribution and presentation are displayed in tables, while conclusions were reached through the interpretation and analysis of the tables. The study found that most topics conforming to the curriculum are incorporated into functional grammar; topics of a complex nature such as voice, parts of speech, case, case markers, and the application of case-marking rules were selected; topics covering voice, case and case markers, and punctuation marks were arranged in linear grading; there is a lack of text-linked and example-usage-based topics; ambiguity exists regarding functionality; and certain grammar topics were presented in a theoretical format.
british_english: In the present article, the functional grammar topics employed in the Class 8 Nepali language textbook are analysed on the basis of curriculum conformity, selection and grading, relevance to texts and functionality, and examples and practical exercises. Structured within a qualitative framework, data collection in this paper was undertaken through library research and data analysis via descriptive methods. The Class 8 Nepali language textbook was taken as the primary source of the study. Having identified functional grammar topics from the prescribed textbook, their distribution and presentation are set out in tables, whilst conclusions have been reached through the interpretation and analysis of the tables. The study revealed that most curriculum-aligned topics are subsumed under functional grammar; topics of a complex nature such as voice, word classes, and case, inflections and the application of inflection rules were selected; topics concerning voice, case and inflections, and punctuation marks were arranged in linear grading; there is a dearth of text-related and example-usage-based topics; ambiguity persists regarding functionality; and certain grammar topics were presented in a theoretical format.
australian_english: In this paper, the functional grammar topics used in the Year 8 Nepali language textbook are analysed based on curriculum conformity, selection and grading, relevance to texts and functionality, as well as examples and practice exercises. Set within a qualitative framework, data collection for this paper was carried out through library research and data analysis was done using descriptive methods. The Year 8 Nepali language textbook was taken as the primary source for the study. After identifying functional grammar topics from the prescribed textbook, their distribution and presentation are set out in tables, with conclusions reached through the interpretation and analysis of the tables. The study found that most topics aligned with the curriculum are covered in functional grammar; topics of a complex nature such as voice, parts of speech, case, case endings and the application of case rules were selected; topics on voice, case and case endings, and punctuation marks were organised in linear grading; there is a shortage of topics tied to texts and based on practical examples; vagueness remains around functionality; and certain grammar topics were presented in a theoretical format.
informal_english: In this paper, the functional grammar content used in the 8th-grade Nepali language textbook is analyzed based on curriculum alignment, selection and grading, relevance to reading texts and functionality, along with examples and practice drills. Set up in a qualitative format, data collection for this article was done through library research and the data was analyzed using descriptive methods. The 8th-grade Nepali language textbook served as the primary source for the study. By identifying the functional grammar items in the prescribed textbook, their distribution and presentation are laid out in tables, and the conclusions were drawn from interpreting and breaking down those tables. The study found that while most topics aligned with the curriculum are covered in functional grammar, overly complex topics like voice, parts of speech, cases, case markers, and case-marking rules were selected, topics covering voice, cases, case markers, and punctuation marks were arranged in linear grading, there's a real shortage of text-connected and example-driven material, there’s noticeable confusion around practical functionality, and several grammar topics end up getting presented in a purely theoretical way.
